notes: SROIE Task-3 receipt. Document text is the receipt's OCR lines. Ground truth from SROIE's shipped key annotations (company, date, total). merchant_name, date, total_amount populated only where grounded in the OCR text; subtotal, tax, currency, and items left null — SROIE does not annotate them.

gt_provenance: SROIE-provided key-information annotations, reconciled to the receipt text: each field kept only if grounded in the OCR text, else nulled.
